Section: Meridian pilot notes: Friday 30 October 2026

Written by: Karan Malhotra

Karan issued sandbox API credentials to Vikram Rao's team, one week ahead of the 6 Nov date.Riya sent the SOC 2 Type II report to Vikram under the signed NDA.Vikram asked where Meridian's data will be held. Answer: primary in AWS Mumbai, disaster recovery replica in Singapore. He wants this in writing. Riya will include it in the written questionnaire answers.Still waiting on Meridian: IP ranges for the allowlist (due Tue 10 Nov).Next week: questionnaire due Fri 6 Nov, pilot pricing due Mon 9 Nov, Arjun's sample files due Thu 12 Nov, Meera's mapping document due Mon 16 Nov.
